stem: Which of the following points satisfies both inequalities 2x + y <= 10 and x + 3y <= 12 simultaneously?
explanation: Substitute each point into both inequalities. Option 1 gives 9 <= 10 and 12 <= 12, both true. Every other point violates the first constraint.

explanation_sections.punchline: Feasibility check: a point is in the feasible region only when ALL constraints hold simultaneously.
explanation_sections.approach: Substitute each candidate into inequality 1 first (quickest filter), then check inequality 2 only for survivors. For (3,3): 6+3=9<=10 (pass); 3+9=12<=12 (pass). Accept.
explanation_sections.lesson: Always test ALL constraints; a point passing one may still fail another.
explanation_sections.timing: 45 s. Eliminate options 2, 3, 4 on the first inequality in under 30 s.
